result.reason: The added operative language reaches the preferred position: Vendor defends and indemnifies Customer and its Affiliates against third-party IP, legal-compliance, Vendor-caused Customer Data breach, and gross-negligence/wilful-misconduct claims; includes customary IP exclusions, claim procedures, and infringement remedies; and limits Customer's indemnity to Customer-provided content and Customer's breach of law. It also supplies the previously missing Section 20.5 referenced elsewhere. The additions are appropriately scoped and preserve the existing commercial terms. Drafting is professional, though the margin comment contains minor cross-reference inaccuracies (referring to Sections 19.4 and 30.5 rather than the supplied Section 19.5 and an identified provision).
